## 421. Comparing two courses on what they admit (UE9)

UE, a unified explanation of reality, names the second-order direction of 生生 as its seventh item ([plan](../../development/ue-unified-explanation/PLAN.md)). 07's open item asks for a comparison of a range whose widening keeps widening with one merely wider now, never reversing widening and counting neither novelty nor scale. UE4 gave eventual widening and the lag it cannot decide ([§410](410.md#410-widening-on-late-tails-and-what-carries-a-widening-ue4)); UE7 stated what one course keeping widening needs, comparing none ([§419](419.md#419-what-keeping-widening-needs-and-what-carries-it-ue7)). UE9 reads the comparison where widening reads, on what each course admits at each step, and locates what it can be there ([note](../../development/ue9-comparing-courses/NOTE.md)).

**Its standing.** Law 1's one-pair form has the shape of Askell's incomparability argument in infinite ethics, where Pareto, transitivity and permutation invariance force incomparability between infinite worlds; here it runs in one direction only, the exchange is an instance of relative anonymity across formations, and the class form needs no invariance at all. A lag for each admission is the analogue of delayed simulation, a uniform lag of delay games with bounded lookahead; and, as the AI reads it, eventual widening is decided by tails like Chichilnisky's dictatorship of the future. Each law is near-definitional; the contribution is reading them on admitted ranges, where 07's question is posed.

**The review.** An independent read-only review by a separate AI agent ([REVIEW-UE9](../../development/ue9-comparing-courses/REVIEW-UE9.md)) found the Lean sound and the core pure, and the draft claiming more than it showed: 1 error, 5 overclaims, 6 imprecisions, 7 suggestions. The class law needs no exchange and forbids one verdict only; the cycle needs an infinitely wide static course; the lag is decided on the tail side too, so it does not choose between counting early steps and reading tails; the lag order reads names across steps; the exchange admits counting scale. Every finding was taken, the reviewer's probes folded into the module (NOTE §6), and the reviewed module kept in the kit's history as the review's evidence. A re-check by another separate AI agent ([RECHECK-UE9](../../development/ue9-comparing-courses/RECHECK-UE9.md)) found every finding resolved and four of the review's own wordings saying more than the Lean: 0 errors, 1 overclaim, 6 imprecisions, 10 suggestions. The narrowing of 07's Open item needed "by name", since along a merging continuation listed static courses close the cycle too; the class law holds on its web, infinite width being necessary and not sufficient; the static course of each pair widens the keeping course of the other, not each course the other's mirror; the exchange is one permutation, an instance of relative anonymity. Every finding was taken but one (one own-condition web over any carrier, which changes a landed module), and five of its six probes were folded in under structural names, the other lags' orders among them as instances of the order lemma (NOTE §6).

**Decisions at landing.** The general lemma (`strictJoin_trans`, `strictJoin_irrefl`) stays in the leaf: it would belong in `Prelude`, and moving it rebuilds every module above. Link composition (`Web.Linked.append`) generalizes the landed `Web.Linked.snoc`; it would belong in `ContinuedClasses`, with `snoc` derived from it, and until its owners move it the general form sits in the leaf beside its special case. UE8's first review found that UE7's passing laws also take requirements never loosening, a hypothesis beside the World premises; 07 §2's theorem and reading, 07's and 02's Open items and the record what-keeping-widening-needs (its statement, law 9 and premises) now say so.

**Readings** [AI reading, D45]. The cycle needs a static course wide enough to include a keeping course of another pair of the class, which no listed static course is. Keeping what the other keeps is closer to "counting neither novelty nor scale" than the exchange: neither novelty nor scale can outweigh a lasting loss. Widening with a lag ranks courses by what each keeps of the other's admissions over time, closer to nothing lost across time than to a range whose widening keeps widening, so the second order, if it is read at all, is read on what a course keeps reachable or on what carries its openings.
